## Objective
- Build a complete, playable one-hand roguelike inspired by The Binding of Isaac.

## Requirements
- Build now without clarification; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them on completion.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for checks (viewport at most 1280px wide); read only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Implemented an original browser game titled “ONE HAND — Basement Crawl,” with automatic targeting/firing and keyboard and touch movement controls.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created a self-contained playable game in `index.html` with generated rooms, enemies, combat, drops, upgrades, health, dashing, pause, and restart.
- Verified JavaScript syntax with Node.

### Active
- Browser check remains to be done.

### Blocked
- Initial browser launch failed because Chromium was not installed; `playwright-cli install-browser chromium` subsequently completed successfully.

## Next Move
1. Open `http://localhost:3002` with `playwright-cli`.
2. Verify the start screen and gameplay, check browser console, and save/read the latest small JPEG screenshot.
3. Fix any issues found and summarize the game and assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Complete game implementation.

## Important Context
- `node -e "const fs=require('fs');const s=fs.readFileSync('index.html','utf8').match(/<script>([\\s\\S]*?)<\\/script>/)[1];new Function(s);console.log('JavaScript syntax OK')"` passed.
- A Python server was started with `python3 -m http.server 3002`; it may still be running.
- No commit was made.
